concerns.text: T009d (Download Gold Standard) and T009c (Process Gold Standard) are listed as prerequisites for T027 (Judge Calibration) and T027b (Validation). However, T009d references `lmsys/lmsys-chatbot-arena` which the Analyze report flags as failing to provide the required 'character arc' ground truth. T041 (Phase 7) proposes a fix (manual/static dataset), but T041 is placed AFTER the tasks it depends on (T027). The consumer (T027) cannot execute before the producer (T041) creates the valid artifact. This is a hard ordering violation blocking the entire US3 pipeline.

T018 (Semantic Similarity Check) and T019 (Regeneration Loop) depend on a 'source text corpus' to compare against. T042 (Phase 7) identifies the missing task to download/verify `data/raw/arcane_corpus.jsonl`. Currently, T018/T019 are scheduled to run before the corpus exists. The producer of the corpus (T042) must precede the consumers (T018/T019). Without this, the 'Out-of-World' validation logic is impossible to execute.

T030 (Shapiro-Wilk test) explicitly reads from `data/derived/results.jsonl`. T026a (Aggregate Scores) writes to `data/derived/results_final.jsonl`. The dependency graph implies T030 consumes T026a's output, but the file paths do not match. T030 will fail to find data or read an undefined intermediate file. The producer (T026a) must write to the file the consumer (T030) reads, or T030 must be updated to read `results_final.jsonl`.

T009 (Unit test for axis semantic overlap) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) and placed before T010/T011. The task description admits: 'This test depends on T010a/T010b (schema) and T011 (service) being implemented first'. A test cannot be written/validated before the schemas and services it tests exist. While TDD writes the test file first, the task 'Unit test for...' implies the test must pass or be runnable. If it implies 'write the file', it should not be marked [P] if it relies on the existence of the schema files (T010) to define the test data strategies. More critically, T011a depends on T012, but T012 is listed after T011a. T011a calls T012's logic; T012 must precede T011a.

Phase 7 tasks (T041-T045) are listed as 'Revision & Analysis Resolution' but are placed AFTER the tasks they are meant to fix (e.g., T041 fixes T009d, T042 fixes T018). In a dependency graph, the fix (producer of the correct data/schema) must precede the consumer. Placing the fix in Phase 7 implies the experiment (Phase 5) runs with broken data. These tasks must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 3/4 (US1/US2) to ensure the data artifacts exist before the dependent tasks run.

T011a (Implement axis_input.py) lists 'Depends on: T010a, T010b, T012'. T012 (Implement semantic validation logic) is listed AFTER T011a in the task list. A task cannot depend on a task that appears later in the execution order unless the order is explicitly re-sequenced. T012 must precede T011a.
